messages:
maria: Quick ping — PR #4321 is up for review (tracehook wiring + metrics rollup for Console). Hoping to merge in today's release window. Main changes: trace hook plumbing, unify metric names, small migration. Can someone take a look?

jon: Looking now. Quick skim: overall looks solid. One question about metric naming — we currently emit `metrics.trace.duration_ms`, could we move to `trace.duration_ms` to match the rest of the console metrics?

sam: @jon @maria grabbing a local run. Unit tests pass but I hit an e2e failure around sampling logic, investigating. :eyes:

sam: Found the flake — test assumed deterministic sampling. Pushed a small test fix and a seed in the harness. Rebased onto main, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/main...sam:tracehook-rollup (PR #4321)

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for PR #4321...

deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green (build/tests/lint). Staging deploy queued.

leo: Small nit: can you add a one-liner docstring on TraceHook.handle_event explaining the sampling behavior? helps future debuggers. Example: 
```py
def handle_event(self, event):
    """Process event and forward sampled traces to metrics pipeline. Sampling is probabilistic and deterministic per request id."""
```

sam: Added docstring and addressed @jon's metric rename to `trace.duration_ms`. Also removed a stray debug log. PTAL @jon @leo.

jon: Re-ran tests locally, all green. One more tiny thing: remove the explicit `time.sleep(0.1)` in TestTraceSampling — it causes flakes in CI. Replace with wait_for_condition util.

sam: Done — switched to wait_for_condition. Pushed and force-pushed the rebase.

maria: Thanks team. If no other objections I'll merge during the 3pm release window (in ~10m). Please add :thumbsup: if you approve.

leo: +1 :thumbsup: — approved.

jon: +1 — LGTM.

deploy-bot: Merge scheduled: PR #4321 will merge on next release window. Canary deploy starting in 10 minutes. Monitor console/dashboards for any regression.

maria: Great — thanks everyone, will follow canary metrics and escalate if anything looks off.
